Final for Publication

23097-T1
SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1724 North Dayton Street
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property

The property is located in an RT-4 zoning district in an area that includes residential buildings, many of them

three stories in height.

The property is improved with a three story single family home (41’-10 4” height). The property includes an
attached garage with a garage roof deck. The third floor features a penthouse that is used for living space. The
subject building encroaches onto the required side setbacks and exceeds the maximum Floor Area Ratio for an
RT-4 zoned property.

The Project

Andrey Timofeev and Ekaterina Timofeeva (the “Applicants”) seek to renovate their home. They propose to
construct a third floor partial addition. The attached garage and garage roof deck will remain. The building height
will remain the same.

To allow the proposed project the Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

The Applicants are also seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-
B to reduce the required north side minimum side yard setback per section 17-2-0309 from 2.0’ to 1’-3”
(existing); 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required south side minimum.
side yard setback per section 17-2-0309 from 2.0’ to 1’-3” (existing); 3) an optional variation under section
17-13-1101-B to reduce the required minimum combined side yard setback per section 17-2-0309 from
4.8” to 2’-6”; 4) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B reduce the rear yard setback per section
17-2-0306-B from 34.86’ to zero; and 5) an optional variation under section 1 7-2-0307-A(5), 17-13-1003-
K, and 17-13-1101-A to relocate 255.0 square feet (existing) of rear yard open space to the garage roof
deck per section 17-2-0307.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,988 square feet

FAR: 14

Total Building Floor Area: 4,083 square feet

Height: 4l’-10 4%”

Automobile Parking: 2

Rear Yard Open Space: 255 square feet*

Setbacks: Front (West/Dayton Street): 14°-4 4"
Side (North): 1-3" *
Side (South): 3” *
Rear (East / Alley): zero*

Aset of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks all available and optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
